title: HJERPEFINTE
subtitle: Table hockey · centre feint · the goalie must expect a Hjerpe
end_steps: HJERPE STANCE, PUCK ON THE BLADE

setup.title: THE SET-UP
setup.text: One puck in front of the blue line, back to the goal, puck out on the right of the blade. From here the centre can also play a Hjerpe to the left. The goalie still covers the right side.

beats.title: THE FEINT
beats.text: The stance sells the Hjerpe. The goalie reads it and starts to slide to the left post.

beats.title: THE SHOT
beats.text: As the goalie commits to the left post, the centre turns counter-clockwise and pushes the puck straight into the right corner the goalie is leaving.
beats.label: SHOT · BLADE PUSH
